Name: 8-bit Girlfriend
Overview:
8-bit Girlfriend offers something lacking in most old school RPGs: The ability to date the no name characters the heroes come across in their journey through the lands. Pick between four different girls (Princess, Elf, Thief and Item Shop Girl) and try to chat them up in order to secure a date for Sir Knight, the game's main protagonist.

Gameplay consists of picking the appropriate answer to conversational pieces offered up by the girls (usually 2-4 options). A favorsome reply results in the player moving on to the next part of the conversation, while giving the wrong answer results in instant failure, a broken heart and absolutely no chance of a date.
